scope: Proposed standalone synthetic contracts. JSON schemas are design artifacts, not an implemented supervisor, endpoint or runtime validator.

units.a_cmd: Dynamic Fx_total/m; no dynamics or actuator conversion is implemented by S1.
units.time: Control ticks times exact rational tick_period_s in seconds. Preserve source SI timestamps; no N*dt inference.

clock_rules: Scheduler time never decreases. Complete externally scheduled input batches are sealed before timestamp processing.
ClockStamp mappings yield conservative inclusive integer bounds. Unknown mapping has null bounds plus reason and denies dependent permission.
Source SI times not exactly on the configured tick grid are mapped outward; never round start earlier or expiry later.
Packet source timestamps must strictly increase; corresponding bounds must have matching lengths and each previous upper bound < next lower bound. Unresolved order denies acceptance.
authority_start_tick equals the upper bound of the first timestamp; authority_end_tick equals the lower bound of the last timestamp. Require start < end.
Permission and packet authority use [start,end). Application upper bound < end; held_until <= end. No command may stay logically authorized at end.
Conservative order uses max(capture) <= min(generation) <= requested <= min(application), with max(application) <= latest < permission end.
For every application/hold instant, age upper bound is instant upper bound minus capture lower bound. It must remain within the explicitly configured policy bound.
Unknown or absent configured freshness bound denies nominal grants; no default is inferred from the proposed 50 ms Perception hypothesis.
semantic_rules: All JSON numbers must be finite; reject NaN, Infinity, booleans-as-numbers and malformed or unknown fields/versions.
Required null values carry a nonempty reason in their record or Trace. Unknown never becomes zero, false rest or a successful acknowledgement.
Evidence is supplied named synthetic assumption data, bound to current context, state/packet and [valid_from,valid_until). It proves no physical domain.
VALID estimate requires finite six-state data, capture/publication/receipt ordering, configured map/frame, reviewed uncertainty interpretation and nonexpired health evidence.
COVARIANCE alone never satisfies bounded-set containment; covariance may be recorded while eligibility remains UNKNOWN.
DEGRADED, INVALID, MISSING, stale or unresolved estimates deny new nominal grants. Existing continuation needs separate named eligible evidence or enters NO_VALID_POLICY.

A PROPOSAL_READY record never changes active authority. AUTHORITY_ACCEPT requires causal acceptance evidence and ready <= accepted; FIXED mode additionally needs ready <= fixed deadline and accepted == deadline.

At most one active nominal owner. Replacing authority revokes affected grants and requires a matching new-epoch barrier; a matching preacknowledged barrier may be consumed in the same timestamp batch. No new-epoch grant/commit before installation is acknowledged.
Packet-derived permissions cannot end after original packet expiry, including explicit reauthorization; generations and source identities remain immutable.
NOMINAL commands require a source packet. Non-packet commands require a named policy, nonpacket_reason and eligible matching evidence; no default braking command exists.

payload_utf8 contains the immutable original UTF-8 JSON command object excluding payload_utf8 and payload_sha256. Reject duplicate JSON keys; parse finite numbers as exact decimals and require equality with all other command fields. payload_sha256 hashes those exact UTF-8 bytes without reserialization. Different encodings have different digests and cannot masquerade as an exact duplicate.

First authenticated well-formed command in a recognized session consumes its producer sequence even if denied. Exact duplicate ID/digest returns original outcome without a new grant or application. Conflicting ID/digest latches IDENTITY_CONFLICT; older unseen sequence is rejected.
Reauthorization creates a new permission ID in current epoch, preserving command ID, original packet and generation epoch. Only a still-unapplied, uncancelled command may be reauthorized.
A permission is a conditional logical lease, not an application observation. APPLICATION_CHECK reads current state again and grants no indefinite hold.

S1-B ENDPOINT_COMMIT checks endpoint-local epoch/session, cancellation ledger, freshness, current locally received evidence, previous simulated application and independently supplied synthetic constraint evidence immediately before commit. Missing prior-input/constraint evidence denies commit; no physical rate limit is invented.

Endpoint cannot know undelivered host revocations. Host request, endpoint installation, acknowledgement and application are distinct events. Snapshot endpoint epoch is last acknowledged knowledge; EndpointSnapshot installed epoch is endpoint-local truth in B.

BarrierAck is separate from application feedback: accept only matching target session, epoch, barrier ID and known queue-cleared installation; delivery <= installation <= acknowledgement observation. UNKNOWN cannot complete a barrier. A fixture EPOCH_INSTALL fact alone never updates acknowledged host knowledge.
Cancellation acknowledgement before commit prevents future commit. TOO_LATE preserves prior application; absent acknowledgement remains UNKNOWN.
Rejecting/revoking permission does not erase or neutralize a held input. Expiry without an eligible continuation/response latches NO_VALID_POLICY and retains unknown/held observations.

S1-A must reject endpoint delivery and ENDPOINT_COMMIT operations as STAGE_NOT_ENABLED. EndpointObservation, BarrierAck and EPOCH_INSTALL facts in A are supplied fixture evidence, not endpoint execution. No stage produces physical feedback.

S1-B COMMAND_DELIVER/PERMISSION_DELIVER/ENDPOINT_ESTIMATE_DELIVER/ENDPOINT_EVIDENCE_DELIVER mutate only local received state. Late grants cannot resurrect an obsolete epoch or a cancelled/applied command.

perception_adapter.publication_latency: Map source capture/publication intervals first; conservatively compute [publication_min-capture_max, publication_max-capture_min]. Negative/inconsistent chronology is invalid; unavailable measurement stays null with reason. Receipt latency is separate.
perception_adapter.adoption_gate: Obtain versioned producer contract, units/frame/map and uncertainty semantics; separate Control/Perception review and integration authorization.

schema_limit: Structural schemas alone do not check cross-record identity, chronology, uncertainty containment or safety; semantic rules and independent oracles are mandatory design obligations.
